title: New test_role_absent_demand_inert double-frees the trimmed entries array (tracking allocator flags 'bad free')
evidence:
core/demand_test.odin:
	e3 := &cat2.demand.eras[2]
	trimmed := make([dynamic]Demand_Entry, 0, 4, context.allocator)
	defer delete(trimmed)
	...
	delete(e3.entries)
	e3.entries = trimmed
core/catalog.odin:976-983:
	catalogs_destroy :: proc(cat: ^Catalogs) {
		...
		for i in 0..<len(cat.demand.eras) {
			delete(cat.demand.eras[i].entries)
Runtime (odin test core, this worktree):
	[WARN ] ... :: core.test_role_absent_demand_inert
		+++ bad free        @ 0xD2A801478 [catalog.odin:982:catalogs_destroy()]
detail: Defers run LIFO: `delete(trimmed)` fires, then `catalogs_destroy(cat2)` frees `cat2.demand.eras[2].entries` — the same array — again. Empirically flagged 'bad free' (undefined behavior) yet odin test exits 0, so the '10/10 gates green' claim masks it.
recommended_fix: Delete the `defer delete(trimmed)` line — after `e3.entries = trimmed` the catalog owns the array and catalogs_destroy(cat2) frees it (the original array is already freed by `delete(e3.entries)`).

title: W9 re-pin seeds the entire aggregation crowd, making the 'growth must place' assertions vacuous — a total growth regression still passes
detail: 8 hosts + 6 campuses are seeded directly, so hosts starts at 14 and campuses at 6: both existence checks can never fail, and the seeded crowd alone (25.7/tick capacity vs the 20/tick ask) satisfies MIN_LAND. With growth completely broken this test still passes, despite its header claiming 'the re-tuned trio (… growth interval 40) is RE-VALIDATED TOGETHER here' and the assertion message saying 'growth must place'.
recommended_fix: Either count growth-added terminals separately (nodes beyond the seeded 20) and assert growth contributes, or reword the assertion/header to say the crowd is seeded; keep growth-integration coverage in another pin.

title: PR claims the campus half 'must land fully' (per-role honest floor), but the only campus-specific assertion is `campus_window_spawns > 0`
evidence:
core/demand_test.odin:725:
	testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns > 0, "the honest surge floor requires a campus to SOURCE in the window (got %d in-window campus spawns)", campus_window_spawns)
PR body: '**Campus half hard-pinned**: ≥1 campus must exist AND source in the window (a campus-silent pass is a regression), and the campus half lands fully (measured 100%).' and 'the honest floor is per-role (campus half 100%, total ≥95% on a grown mesh)'
detail: The 'lands fully' campus floor is only a one-time measurement, not a pin: campuses sourcing as little as one packet pass, and the aggregate ≥95% gate lets the campus share fall to roughly 50-84% (hosts at capacity + growth-born hosts make up the difference) without failing.
recommended_fix: Add an explicit per-role floor, e.g. campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100, or soften the PR/body claim to 'total ≥95% with campus sourcing >0'.
